en: n. a book with exercises for students to write answers in; a book for recording work or notes; a computer file with many worksheets
ex: The teacher asked us to complete page ten of the workbook.
老師要我們完成習作簿的第十頁。

en: n. a long thin soft creature with no legs that lives in soil; a person who is weak or unimportant; vi. to move slowly through a small space; vt. to make your way slowly or secretly
ex: The bird pulled a worm out of the ground.
小鳥從地裡拉出一條蟲。
ph: the early bird catches the worm

en: a. of lower quality or standard than something else; more serious or severe; adv. in a less good way; n. something that is more unpleasant or bad
ex: The traffic today is even worse than yesterday.
今天的交通比昨天還糟。

en: a. the most bad or unpleasant of all; adv. in the worst way; n. the most bad or unpleasant thing or time
ex: This is the worst storm we have had in years.
這是我們多年來最嚴重的暴風雨。
ph: if the worst comes to the worst

en: n. a piece of paper or cloth that covers something; a loose piece of clothing worn around the shoulders; a soft food in a flatbread; vt. to cover something by putting paper or cloth around it; vi. to finish a task
ex: Please wrap the gift in colorful paper.
請用彩色紙把禮物包起來。

en: n. a large thick root vegetable that grows underground and is cooked and eaten, similar to a sweet potato
ex: Grandma cooked yam soup with ginger on a cold day.
天冷時，奶奶煮了山藥薑湯。

en: a. happening once a year or every year; adv. once a year; every year
ex: The company holds a yearly meeting for all its employees.
公司每年為全體員工召開一次年會。

en: n. a young person or a child
ex: The youngster ran across the playground with a ball.
那個小孩拿著球跑過操場。

en: n. the time of life when someone is young; a young person, usually a young man; young people considered as a group; the quality of being young
ex: In his youth, he enjoyed hiking in the mountains.
他年輕時喜歡在山裡健行。

en: n. an area that is different from the areas around it because of a particular feature or purpose; vt. to divide an area into zones; vi. to be divided into zones
ex: This area is a no-parking zone on weekdays.
這個區域平日是禁止停車區。

en: a. showing no fear when facing danger or difficulty; willing to do something that is dangerous or difficult
ex: The courageous firefighter saved three children from the burning building.
那位勇敢的消防員從著火的大樓救出了三個孩子。

en: vt. to protect someone or something from attack or harm; to argue in support of someone or something; to protect your title in a sports competition
ex: The soldiers fought hard to defend their country.
士兵們奮力保衛他們的國家。

en: v. to say what you think will happen in the future based on facts or experience
ex: No one can predict exactly what will happen next year.
沒有人能準確預測明年會發生什麼事。

en: n. large machines or the parts of machines considered as a group; a system for organizing something; the way something works
ex: The factory has just installed new machinery.
工廠剛剛裝了新機器。

en: vi. to move more slowly than others and fall behind; to fail to keep up; n. a delay between two events; a period of time between two things; a prisoner; vt. to cover a pipe with insulating material
ex: She began to lag behind the other runners.
她開始落後於其他跑者。

en: a. containing the substances that your body needs to stay healthy and grow; providing nourishment
ex: Eggs are a cheap and nutritious source of protein.
雞蛋是便宜又營養的蛋白質來源。

en: n. special importance given to something; extra force that is put on a word or part of a word when speaking
ex: The school places great emphasis on reading skills.
學校非常強調閱讀能力。

en: n. the act of stopping something from happening; actions taken to stop something bad from happening
ex: Prevention is better than cure.
預防勝於治療。

en: n. a flower, especially on a tree or bush; the state of having flowers open; a period when someone or something is at its best; vi. to produce flowers; to develop and become successful
ex: The cherry trees are in full blossom in spring.
櫻花樹在春天盛開。

en: n. a time or date by which something must be finished
ex: The deadline for submitting the report is Friday.
繳交報告的截止日期是星期五。

en: n. two or more things joined together; a set of numbers or letters that opens a lock; a mix of different things
ex: The combination of good food and good company made the evening special.
美食與好伙伴的結合讓那個夜晚很特別。

en: vt. to make someone feel unhappy because something is not as good as they hoped or expected; to fail to do what someone wanted
ex: I don't want to disappoint my parents.
我不想讓父母失望。

en: n. the careful watching of someone or something; a comment or statement about something that you have seen or noticed; the ability to notice things
ex: Careful observation of the animal's behavior revealed its feeding habits.
仔細觀察這隻動物的行為，就能發現牠的覓食習慣。

en: n. a person who commands a military unit or operation; an officer of a high rank in the armed forces
ex: The commander ordered his troops to retreat.
指揮官命令他的部隊撤退。

en: a. happening as a result of something; following as a logical result; n. something that follows as a result
ex: The company lost money, and the consequent job cuts upset many workers.
公司虧損，隨之而來的裁員讓許多員工難過。

en: n. a long-distance running race of 42.195 kilometers; a very long and difficult task or event that tests endurance
ex: He trained for six months to run a marathon.
他訓練了六個月準備跑一場馬拉松。

en: a. showing approval or support; likely to make something succeed; (of conditions or weather) good for something
ex: The movie received favorable reviews from critics.
這部電影獲得影評人的好評。

en: a. nervous and unable to relax; stretched tight; (of a situation) causing worry; n. a verb form that shows when something happens; vt. to tighten
ex: The atmosphere in the room was tense before the results were announced.
公布結果前，房間裡的氣氛很緊張。

en: vt. to praise someone too much or insincerely to please them; to make someone feel proud; to make someone look attractive
ex: He tried to flatter the boss to get a promotion.
他想奉承老闆以獲得升遷。

en: n. a sound system that produces sound from two or more speakers; a picture or image that appears three-dimensional; a. producing sound from two or more sources; giving a three-dimensional effect
ex: We listened to music on the new stereo.
我們用新的音響聽音樂。

en: n. a group of countries or peoples controlled by one ruler or government, usually after conquest; a very large business organization controlled by one person or group
ex: The Roman Empire once ruled most of Europe.
羅馬帝國曾統治歐洲大部分地區。

en: a. producing a financial gain or benefit; bringing a profit; useful and worthwhile
ex: Running a small restaurant can be very profitable if managed well.
如果經營得宜，開小餐廳可以很賺錢。

en: a. moving in a smooth and attractive way; polite and kind; having a pleasing and elegant shape
ex: The dancer made a graceful turn across the stage.
舞者在舞台上優美地轉了一圈。

en: vt. to make something longer; vi. to become longer
ex: The tailor will lengthen the trousers by three centimeters.
裁縫師會把褲子加長三公分。

en: vt. to give something out to a number of people; to spread something over an area; to share something among a group
ex: The teacher distributed the worksheets to the students.
老師把學習單發給學生。

en: adv. used to add another fact that supports or adds to what has already been said
ex: The plan is too expensive; moreover, it will take too long.
這個計畫太貴；而且，還要花太多時間。

en: a. relating to the rules of grammar; correct according to the rules of grammar
ex: The sentence is not grammatical because it lacks a verb.
這個句子不合文法，因為缺少動詞。

en: a. having a natural ability to do something very well; having a very high level of intelligence or skill
ex: She is a gifted pianist who started playing at age five.
她是一位有天賦的鋼琴家，五歲就開始彈琴。

en: n. the fact of including many different types of people or things; a range of different things
ex: The city is known for its cultural diversity.
這座城市以文化多元聞名。

en: a. relating to or affecting the face; n. a beauty treatment in which the face is cleaned and massaged
ex: She has a facial treatment once a month.
她每個月做一次臉部護理。
